response.final_text:
**Disposition:** CLOSE_FP, proposed. Confidence is 0.80. A human analyst makes the final decision.

**What drove it:**
1. The large BUY (O-00014991, an ICEBERG order of 14416 under parent C-T-X1113-02-A) was executing. It filled 2931, which is 20.3% of its size and well above the 360 opposite quantity. All of those fills came before the SELL, and none came after. This points to genuine execution, so feature (a) is absent.
2. The 360 SELL has a different parent (C-T-X1113-02-B), so it is a separate client order on an agency desk. A small trade made while the iceberg was working, followed by a cancel of the 11485 remainder, is ordinary order management. I did not count it as feature (b).
3. There is no pattern around it. The cycle happened once in the session, and the trader has no prior alerts in 90 days. The order was 1 tick from the touch and a single price level. No market events were recorded.

The BUY was 5.56 times depth, and the price moved 1 tick and reverted 1.5 ticks. Both facts are in the report, but I did not treat them as a benefit.

**What would change my mind:** Evidence that the SELL under parent B and the BUY under parent A are one beneficial decision. A repeat of this one-sided iceberg pattern on other days or later in the session would also change it.
